chain.label: King Air A90 crew failed to monitor/announce on CTAF
chain.trigger: failure of the pilots in the King Air A90 to effectively monitor the common traffic advisory frequency ... the King Air A90 flight crew failed to announce its takeoff intentions on the common traffic advisory frequency

chain.label: King Air A90 crew failed to scan for traffic
chain.trigger: failure of the pilots in the King Air A90 ... to properly scan for traffic

chain.label: Cherokee pilot's interrupted radio transmission
chain.trigger: the Cherokee pilot's transmission in response to flight 5925's request was unnecessary and inappropriate

chain.label: 1900C crew misunderstood transmission as King Air's hold confirmation
chain.trigger: mistook the Cherokee pilot's transmission ... and therefore mistakenly believed that the King Air was not planning to take off until after flight 5925 had cleared the runway

caused_by.evidence: led to the Beech 1900C pilot's misunderstanding of the transmission as an indication from the King Air that it would not take off until after flight 5925 had cleared the runway

chain.label: King Air A90 commenced takeoff roll on intersecting runway
chain.trigger: commencing a takeoff roll when the Beech 1900C (United Express flight 5925) was landing on an intersecting runway

caused_by.evidence: failure ... to effectively monitor the common traffic advisory frequency ... resulting in their commencing a takeoff roll
failure ... to properly scan for traffic, resulting in their commencing a takeoff roll

chain.label: Runway collision at intersection of runways 13 and 4
chain.trigger: the Beech 1900C ... and the King Air A90 ... collided at the intersection of the two runways

caused_by.evidence: commencing a takeoff roll when the Beech 1900C was landing on an intersecting runway
the 1900C pilots may have been less concerned about continuing to watch the King Air A90 during their landing

chain.label: Air stair door on the 1900C could not be opened
chain.trigger: the air stair door was not opened ... neither [rescuer] was able to open the door ... the Board could not determine the most likely reason that the air stair door was not opened

chain.label: On-airport ARFF equipment not staffed at Quincy
chain.trigger: Quincy Municipal Airport had an ARFF truck, [but] it was not staffed at the time of the accident because no air carrier aircraft with more than 30 passenger seats were taking off or landing

chain.label: 14 occupants killed from smoke inhalation and thermal injury
chain.trigger: The 2 flight crewmembers and all 10 passengers aboard the 1900C were killed, and the 2 occupants aboard the King Air A90 were killed ... succumbed to smoke inhalation and thermal injuries because they were unable to exit the airplane

caused_by.evidence: The 2 flight crewmembers and all 10 passengers aboard the 1900C were killed, and the 2 occupants aboard the King Air A90 were killed
the failure of the air stair door on the Beech 1900C to be opened was a contributing factor to the severity of the accident and the loss of life
Contributing to the severity of the accident and the loss of life were the lack of adequate aircraft rescue and fire fighting services
